Visual similarity review

For each query on the left, decide which of the numbered results actually look like it — same kind of garment, comparable colour and pattern. Record a 1 or a 0 in the visually_similar column of outputs/similarity_review.csv, matched on query and rank.

Labels are withheld on purpose: the point is to judge appearance, not to agree with the metadata the automatic metric already uses.
